findings.claim: Lam 10-K 列出技術快速變遷為風險：公司須持續開發新產品以因應製程技術變化，產品若在市場失敗或不及競品改良版，可能損失市占；10-K 未點名具體替代技術。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Rapid technological changes in semiconductor manufacturing processes subject us to increased pressure to develop technological advances that enable those processes.

findings.claim: 10-K 產品集中風險項下列有「技術變化我們無法因應」與「競爭對手改良版產品」等情境。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: an improved version of products being offered by a competitor in the markets in which we participate; •increased pressure from competitors that offer broader product lines; •increased pressure from regional competitors; •technological changes that we are unable to address with our products;
